1	"""Clash detection between bookings."""
2	
3	from dataclasses import dataclass
4	
5	
6	@dataclass(frozen=True)
7	class Booking:
8	    id: str
9	    room: str
10	    start: int  # minutes since midnight
11	    end: int  # exclusive
12	
13	
14	def overlaps(a: Booking, b: Booking) -> bool:
15	    return a.room == b.room and a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end
16	
17	
18	def find_overlaps(bookings: list[Booking]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
19	    """Return every clashing pair as (id_a, id_b) with id_a < id_b, sorted.
20	
21	    Two bookings clash when they are in the same room and their half-open
22	    intervals intersect. A booking fully inside a longer one clashes with it;
23	    a booking that ends exactly when another starts does not.
24	    """
25	    pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
26	    for i in range(len(bookings)):
27	        a = bookings[i]
28	        for j in range(i + 1, len(bookings)):
29	            b = bookings[j]
30	            if overlaps(a, b):
31	                pairs.append((a.id, b.id) if a.id < b.id else (b.id, a.id))
32	    pairs.sort()
33	    return pairs
34

20	def find_overlaps(bookings: list[Booking]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
21	    """Return every clashing pair as (id_a, id_b) with id_a < id_b, sorted.
22	
23	    Two bookings clash when they are in the same room and their half-open
24	    intervals intersect. A booking fully inside a longer one clashes with it;
25	    a booking that ends exactly when another starts does not.
26	
27	    Implemented as a per-room sweep in start order: a min-heap keyed on end
28	    holds the bookings still running at the current start, so the work is
29	    O(n log n) plus one comparison per reported clash rather than one per pair.
30	    """
31	    by_room: dict[str, list[Booking]] = {}
32	    for b in bookings:
33	        by_room.setdefault(b.room, []).append(b)
34	
35	    pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
36	    for in_room in by_room.values():
37	        in_room.sort(key=attrgetter("start"))
38	        active: list[tuple[int, int, Booking]] = []  # (end, tie-breaker, booking)
39	        for seq, b in enumerate(in_room):
40	            while active and active[0][0] <= b.start:
41	                heappop(active)
42	            for _, _, a in active:
43	                if overlaps(a, b):
44	                    pairs.append((a.id, b.id) if a.id < b.id else (b.id, a.id))
45	            heappush(active, (b.end, seq, b))
46	    pairs.sort()
47	    return pairs
